page.notes: Left margin: the narrow column of marginal words runs down the left side, and I placed each item beside the line where it stands. Many words are in an old, faded, cramped print. Their exact letters are uncertain and are marked with [?] in the text. The Latin spellings have been read as far as the scan allows. The lines in the lower part of the page are close to illegible, and some readings there (e.g. "decoction", "scenu-") are best guesses that should be checked against a clearer copy. Ligatures (ct, st, æ) are rendered as plain letters where the scan is unclear. The running head reads "DE VITA" and the page number is 238.
